title: Every proper ideal is contained in a maximal ideal
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $I\subseteq R$ an ideal with $I\neq R$. Then there is a maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\subset R$ with $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$. In particular every nonzero commutative ring has a maximal ideal, and every prime ideal of $R$ is contained in a maximal ideal of $R$.
